title: 全美航空系统：还跑在软盘和铜线上，500亿能一夜修好吗？
speaker: John Pistole

segments.en: Yeah, what accounts for the intractability of this system? I look at the New York times this morning and this line stood out to me in particular, for decades, air traffic communications have
segments.zh: 是什么导致这个系统如此难以改变？我今天早上看《纽约时报》，有一句话特别引人注意：几十年来，空中交通通信一直

segments.en: relied on a system that runs on analog copper wire floppy disks and alphabetical keyboards.
segments.zh: 依赖一个运行在模拟铜线、软盘和字母键盘上的系统。

segments.en: So old the FAA has difficulty sourcing spare parts. Why is this persistent as long as it has?
segments.zh: 太旧了，以至于FAA连备件都难以采购。为什么这个问题能持续这么久？

segments.en: Well, that's a great question. And I think there should be a lot of attention paid to just that question. And Secretary Duff does his credit. He's, he's asking for $50 billion to try to fix all this.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题，我认为应该高度重视。达菲部长值得肯定，他正申请500亿美元来修复这一切。

segments.en: But even if, if the Congress gave him a check today for $50 billion, this, this is not an overnight fix.
segments.zh: 但即使国会今天给他一张500亿美元的支票，这也不是一夜之间能解决的。

segments.en: And so it's something that if, as you update systems, especially going from, as you said, floppy disks and copper wire to fiber optics and everything else, that's not an overnight fix.
segments.zh: 所以，随着系统更新，特别是从你说的软盘和铜线转向光纤等新技术，这不是一夜之间能完成的。

segments.en: And so this has been something that people in the business have known about for years, for decades, in terms of saying, this needs to be modernized. And what are we doing to focus our
segments.zh: 这是业内多年来、几十年来都知道的事情，都说需要现代化。我们正在如何集中

segments.en: attention and our efforts to make sure that the 27, 28,000 flights a day that take off every day typically in the US are safe and secure. And so that's, that's what I think everybody's focused
segments.zh: 注意力和努力，确保美国每天通常起飞的2.7万到2.8万架次航班安全可靠。所以我认为大家都在关注

segments.en: on to say, what have we been doing? What can we do now? And what should we do? And what must we do?
segments.zh: 的是：我们一直在做什么？现在能做什么？应该做什么？必须做什么？

segments.en: Tomorrow to say, okay, let's get this fixed.
segments.zh: 明天就说，好，让我们把它修好。
